options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Goal
options.doc:
The goal of the run. This consists of any number of the following structure:

- An action, one of:
    - “Create” - Create this treasure at the largest size.
    - “Unlock” - Receive this treasure from another player, or use a ticket to get it.
    - “Check” - Complete the check at this treasure (The requirements to unlock it in the base game.)
    - “Merge” - Merge two of this treasure at the largest size, destroying them.

- A target, one of:
    - One or more name(s) of treasure(s).
    - A number, indicating how many different treasures this needs to be done for.
    - “all”

    - Créer - Créez ce trésor à la plus grande taille.
    - Débloquer - Recevez ce trésor d'un autre joueur, ou utilisez un ticket pour l'obtenir.
    - (Les exigences pour le déverrouiller dans le jeu de base.)
    - Merge - Fusionnez deux de ce trésor à la plus grande taille, les détruisant.

- Une cible, l'une des:
    - Un ou plusieurs noms de trésors.
    - Un certain nombre, indiquant combien de trésors différents cela doit être fait pour.
    - Tous

Does not work for all checks.
